description: Submits an enquiry so a Showpiece team member contacts the person to arrange a site inspection and a firm quote. Only call this once the person has agreed to be contacted, and pass their real contact details. This does not book anything or commit anyone to a contract.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or app submitting this, if any.

company_name.description: Business or organisation that needs cleaning.

contact_consent.description: Must be true: the person has agreed to Showpiece contacting them about this enquiry.

contact_name.description: Full name of the person Showpiece should contact.

estimate_shown.description: If you gave the person an indicative price from estimate_cleaning_price, repeat the range here, e.g. "$6,250 - $8,100 per month ex GST".

hours_per_week.description: Total cleaning hours per week, if known.

notes.description: Anything else relevant: access, hours, current cleaner, special requirements.

preferred_start.description: When they would like cleaning to start, e.g. "January 2027".

site_address.description: Street address of the site to be cleaned.

visits_per_week.description: Desired visits per week, if known.

name: request_site_inspection
title: Request a site inspection and quote
